canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted keys; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; trailing newline excluded

data.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 incremental ORDER BY symbol,date; symbol UTF-8 + NUL + date ASCII + NUL + big-endian IEEE-754 open/high/low/close doubles + signed 64-bit integer volume
data.fingerprint_pending_reason: specification locked before data fetch; fingerprint recorded once the 12-ETF universe is present on the executing machine, per protocol Implementation and artifact contract step 3

signal.volatility_estimator: trailing 20-session close-to-close log-return standard deviation, annualized by sqrt(252) -- shared with SMA Cross v1's volatility-state placebo estimator, used here as both the trend-signal normalizer and the vol-scaling weight denominator
signal.primary_variant_note: the literal SMA lookback already named in Cycle 2's Candidate C record; only the primary can produce material_and_consistent, closing off variant cherry-picking by construction

weights.definition: w_i(t) = max(Trend_i(t), 0) / sigma_20_i(t), sum-normalized across assets to at most 1.0 (no leverage); an all-non-positive-trend day yields an all-zero row (100% cash at zero yield)

placebo.definition: w_placebo_i(t) = (1 / sigma_20_i(t)) / sum_j(1 / sigma_20_j(t)) -- direction-blind, always fully invested, shares the exact same sigma_20 estimator
placebo.rationale: Cycle 2's own Cross-candidate findings named this mechanism as a rival explanation for Candidate C's own result and required it be shared, not separately re-litigated

benchmark.definition: continuous, no-cost, daily-rebalanced equal-weight (1/12) index: r_benchmark(t) = mean_i(r_i(t))
benchmark.note: a further deliberate simplification of ADR 0005's real annually-rebalanced, whole-share, costed Passive ETF-12 v1, used only for this no-trade comparison so neither side carries costs or drift the other does not

warm_up_rationale: widest lookback across all three variants (secondary variant C's SMA_350), so every variant is fully warmed up from the sample's first evaluated day; DBC inception (2006-02-06) plus 350 sessions keeps 2008 inside the evaluated sample

bootstrap.extension_required: none -- reused completely unchanged for both the primary significance test on each variant's excess-return series and the primary-vs-placebo paired test on the difference series

correction.family_definition: 3 lookback variants (A, B, C), Holm-corrected together; the placebo is compared via the separate paired test below, not pooled into this family

gates.materiality_rationale: low enough not to demand an unrealistically large edge from a no-cost characterization test, high enough to sit clearly above this project's locked round-trip cost defaults (10 bp commission/side, 2 bp spread, 5 bp slippage)
gates.placebo_rule: primary variant's mean daily excess return strictly exceeds the placebo's point estimate AND the primary-minus-placebo difference series clears p <= 0.05 on the same bootstrap procedure
gates.placebo_rule_rationale: a bare point-estimate comparison is exactly the gate Overnight-Gap's pre-lock review found gives little real discriminating power between two correlated statistics; the paired test applies that lesson here
gates.reproducibility: byte-identical excess-return series, p-values, and weight-share diagnostics on an independent rerun against the same fingerprinted data

diagnostics_non_gating.regime_concentration: mean daily excess return of the primary variant, excluding 2008, excluding 2020, excluding 2022 separately
diagnostics_non_gating.asset_weight_concentration: each asset's mean weight share over the full sample, primary variant

multiplicity.variant_count_note: 3 lookback variants plus the required placebo

scope_exclusions.no_costs: out of scope for this no-cost characterization run; deferred to any later executable-expression protocol
scope_exclusions.no_further_parameter_search: weight-clip thresholds, alternative vol-scaling estimators, and alternative rebalance timing are all out of scope for this run; any such change is a new, independently justified protocol
